Very heavy constraints — must be air-gapped or run in vetted on-prem appliance, HSM-backed key management, full audit trail, and per-asset model pinning. Team wants the Redwood Private package (customer-managed control plane) with the option to switch to Dedicated if throughput/SLAs require it.

Key quotes from CTO: "We cannot tolerate cross-tenant inference or telemetry leaving the site — prove the binary and audit path." 

Security priorities: SSO (SAML with IdP), SOC/ISO artifacts are table-stakes, require FIPS HSM for key material and 7-year retention controls for logs tied to incident forensics. Data residency = on-prem only (no cloud egress).

Procurement note: Budget committed from 2026 fiscal cycle but ATO and legal approvals drive timeline. POC scope: 6-week air-gapped POC including on-site install, model validation with red-team prompts, and KV/prefix caching behavior tests.

Sales strategy so far: initial technical deep-dive with Diego + Maya 2026-02-11 (Fireflies above), security review with Redwood infra 2026-03-04 — good alignment but legal requests additional SLA language. Competitive watch: internal self-host and Anthropic enterprise on-prem offering.

Opportunity: high-value account, multi-year private contract if ATO accepted. Next: deliver air-gapped architecture, provide HSM integration notes and sample ATO artifacts (SOC2 + encryption attestations).
